name: TIMIT Acoustic-Phonetic Continuous Speech Corpus
description: TIMIT is a foundational acoustic-phonetic speech corpus designed for phoneme recognition and acoustic modeling. Comprising 6,300 phonetically rich sentences spoken by 630 speakers from 8 major dialect regions of the United States, complete with time-aligned word and phonetic transcriptions.
